name: What to Ask Before Hiring a Garage Addition Contractor

mainEntity.name: What should I ask a garage addition contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask a garage addition contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a garage addition contractor, homeowners should focus on experience, communication, and permit knowledge. Ask to see similar local projects and request a clear explanation of how they handle permits, engineering, inspections, and unexpected site issues. It is also important to ask whether the bid includes demolition, grading, drainage, utility work, and cleanup, because those items can easily be missed. In Los Angeles County, local permitting familiarity is especially important since requirements can differ by city. A strong contractor should explain the likely sequence of work, the expected timeline, and the biggest risks that could affect cost. Homeowners should also ask who will be on site, how often updates are provided, and how change orders are approved. The best contractor is usually the one who gives specific, written answers instead of vague assurances.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about recent local projects, permit handling, insurance, schedule, exclusions, change orders, and who will manage inspections. You should also ask whether they have experience with your city’s zoning rules, site conditions, and garage-specific code requirements.
